payload.title: As-of date for maturity bucketing uses the file's Reporting Date, not calendar today
payload.decision: When a snapshot file's single Reporting Date is earlier than the current calendar date, maturity horizons (e.g. "next 7/30/90/365 days") are measured from the file's Reporting Date, not from today. Confirmed with the user for IAM_Deal_Inventory_DUMMY_2026-08-01.xlsx (Reporting Date 2026-08-01, run on 2026-09-25).
applies_to: dated snapshot files with a single Reporting Date

proposals.rationale: Confirmed with user while building deal_inventory_overview report

payload.title: "Maturing in next N days" means cumulative windows, not exclusive buckets
payload.decision: When a question asks for the total amount maturing in the next 7, 30, 90 and 365 days, each number is the cumulative total from the as-of date out to that horizon (so 30d includes everything in 7d, 90d includes everything in 30d, etc.), not a partition into non-overlapping buckets. A separate by-year or by-tenor-bucket table is used when a true partition is wanted. Confirmed with the user for deal_inventory_overview.
applies_to: any maturity/aging report phrased as "next N days"

proposals.rationale: Confirmed with user while building deal_inventory_overview report

payload.title: Large-notional outliers in a deal blotter are usually real deals, not data errors
payload.what_happened: profile_excel.py flagged 90 "extreme outlier" values in Notional in CCY for IAM_Deal_Inventory_DUMMY_2026-08-01.xlsx (up to EUR 834M against a mean of EUR 39M). These were confirmed with the user as legitimate large money-market deals, not entry errors, and were kept in scope for every total.
payload.rule: For deal-level notional/principal columns in a money-market blotter, treat the profiler's statistical outlier flag as a prompt to ask the user, not as a signal to exclude or cap the value. Only drop or adjust a flagged value if the user confirms it is wrong.

proposals.rationale: Confirmed with user while building deal_inventory_overview report
